about.text: Switzerland’s double cream, at least 45 % fat, thick enough to spoon; the double crème of the Gruyère is eaten with meringues.

facts.v: Cannot be whipped; used in place of whipped cream
Heat-stable and acid-resistant; thickens a sauce without flour or starch
From the canton of Fribourg, named after the Gruyères region; sold in all its dairies and the default cream there
